groups.title: Cloud-to-Cloud Connectivity
groups.question: Explain how you would connect private networks on two different cloud providers.

followUps.SD-WAN for Multi-Cloud Network Abstracti: What problem does an SD-WAN layer solve across clouds, and what do you give up by adding it?

groups.title: Private Interconnect Options
groups.question: Walk through how traffic and name lookups should work between clouds when you want to avoid the public internet.

followUps.Multi-Cloud DNS Resolution Strategies: How would you let services on one cloud resolve private hostnames on another, and what breaks if you skip this?

groups.title: Security Across Cloud Perimeters

followUps.BGP Route Filtering and Security: What can go wrong when BGP routes are exchanged between clouds without filters?
